in_marathi.name: Aritra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Path, journey, travel
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aritra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aritra means 'path' or 'journey'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the goddess Durga, who guides her devotees on their spiritual journey towards enlightenment.
